name: @matatbread/matbot-function-fs-guard
description: Node-only: confines a tool_function body's node:fs access to permitted paths by wrapping the imported module through ImportedModuleWrapper. A guardrail against an over-reaching body, not a sandbox. Optional; needs a FunctionRunner that offers ImportedModuleWrapper.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "process.env.MATBOT_PUBLISH_ALL || (console.error('Refused: publish with pnpm publish-all from the repo root. It checks versions, contents and the web bundle first.'), process.exit(1))"
